children: The stock of Godawari Power and Ispat, which has been in a downtrend since May, formed a good base recently. Recently it bounced off this support at ₹190 and broke out of a barrier at ₹213.
The price has now moved above both 21- and 50-day moving averages. Therefore, the stock has turned the outlook positive.
From the current level of ₹220, it can rise to ₹232 where it might witness a brief consolidation. Eventually, the stock can rise past ₹232 and touch ₹252 over the medium-term.

So, traders can buy now at ₹220 and accumulate at ₹213. Place stop-loss at ₹205. When the price hits ₹232, alter the stop-loss to ₹220. On a rally to ₹242, modify the stop-loss to ₹232. Book profits at ₹252.
(Note: The recommendations are based on technical analysis. There is a risk of loss in trading.)

title: Stock to buy today: Godawari Power and Ispat (₹220.05)
